name: The Vibe Suite
description: Ten local-first companions for agentic coding CLIs like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. A skill with an example command is a public npm package that runs on the user's machine next to their agent CLI. Do not invent a command for a skill with no example. Your machine, your keys.

skills.name: viberadio
skills.description: Your agent's output as audio — narration, podcast, or music.

skills.name: vibemovie
skills.description: Your coding session as a short recap video.

skills.name: vibeshare
skills.description: Share your live agent session by URL.

skills.name: vibeads
skills.description: Contextual dev-tool discovery for Claude Code.

skills.name: vibebrand
skills.description: Tokenized brand/design system — CSS design tokens, fonts, and a brand kit. Not published on npm yet.

skills.name: vibecodereview
skills.description: A council of AI models reviews your PR.
